summary: Round 2 documentation/evidence re-review of the Jungfrau pedestal A/B record at 5e8bb5d69212dca801b50a13b1850856c25383d8. The disputed finding JFAB-R1-001 is resolved in the coordinator's favour: psana/psana/datasource.py:92-121 defines _force_mfx_overrides, which sets os.environ['PS_SMD_N_EVENTS']='1000' whenever the experiment name starts with 'mfx' and the variable is unset, and DataSource calls it at line 207 in the 'exp' branch before any SmdReaderManager is built. The pedestal CLI passes exp='mfx100848724' in -k, so the tools.py:14-21 fallback of 20000 is never reached for this workflow; the round-1 inference that the default already yields one chunk was wrong, and the README (lines 8-17) now states both values and the effective 1000 correctly. The committed default-probe.json (initial None, effective 1000, 4 chunks, 4 callbacks, 0 events, UnboundLocalError, exit 1, resolved_sources under /tmp/jf-callback-ab/unfixed) is consistent with the existing unfixed-step stage1-2 entry in results.json (4 chunks/callbacks, 0 events, same exception, exit 1), and the manifest adds digests for the log, rank JSON and effective-value file. run_matrix.py:28-30 sets PS_SMD_N_EVENTS explicitly for every matrix job and commands.json records 'chunk' per job, so the MFX override did not influence the original 20-job matrix and the round-1 analysis stands. JFAB-R1-002/003/004/005 are addressed by README text (lines 44-47, 92-99, 88-90). JFAB-R1-006 remains deferred and untracked by coordinator decision; UtilsJungfrauCalib.py:336/408 is unchanged. No production code, runtime script, results.json or commands.json changed. One new low, non-blocking finding: the outer wrapper that captured the post-run environment value for the probe is not committed.
